case.title: Investment Scam — fastgains-trading.com
case.description: Victim transferred ₹2,50,000 via UPI after being lured by a fraudulent crypto investment platform. Subsequent blockchain activity identified in synthetic dataset.
case.case_story: At 10:31 AM on September 15 2026, a UPI payment of ₹2,50,000 was recorded from the victim's account to UPI ID scam@ybl. Approximately 7 minutes later, on-chain activity was detected at Wallet A (0xa1b2…a9b0) in the synthetic blockchain dataset. The funds subsequently moved through Wallet B, interacted with a bridge contract at 11:02 AM, and arrived at Wallet C on BSC at 11:19 AM before reaching a VASP candidate cluster at 11:25 AM. The relationship between the bank payment and the crypto movement is a potential correlation requiring human verification.

correlations.title: Bank Payment ↔ Blockchain Activity
correlations.description: Amount and temporal proximity detected between UPI payment and on-chain wallet activity.
correlations.explanation: The ₹2,50,000 UPI debit at 10:31:12 is temporally proximate to the first observed wallet activity at 10:38:41 (approximately 7 minutes). The amount corresponds to an approximate crypto equivalent at the time. The wallet address appears in both the chat evidence and the complaint, linking the communication infrastructure to the identified address. This is a potential correlation — human verification is required.

correlations.title: Communication Infrastructure ↔ Wallet
correlations.description: Phone number and website from chat evidence co-occur with identified wallet address.
correlations.explanation: Phone number +91-9876543210 and website fastgains-trading.com appear in both the complaint and the chat export. The same chat messages that referenced the phone number also contained the wallet address 0xa1b2…a9b0. The relationship is inferred from entity co-occurrence in the same evidence source, not from a direct financial transaction record.

gaps.gap_description: No independent evidence directly links the phone number +91-9876543210 to the wallet address 0xa1b2…a9b0.
gaps.why_it_matters: The current connection relies on co-occurrence in the same chat messages. Without a direct financial or registration link, this relationship remains an inference.
gaps.next_action: Search all case evidence and any available OSINT for direct financial or account registration links between the phone number and the wallet address.

gaps.gap_description: VASP attribution for Wallet C is based on prototype synthetic data and has not been independently verified.
gaps.why_it_matters: Without independent verification, the VASP-X candidate attribution cannot support a formal information request.
gaps.next_action: Verify the VASP candidate using an independent attribution source before initiating any formal VASP information request.

gaps.gap_description: The fiat-to-crypto conversion between 10:31 AM and 10:38 AM is not documented in available evidence.
gaps.why_it_matters: The 7-minute gap is consistent with a crypto purchase but is not independently documented. Closing this gap would strengthen the bank-to-blockchain correlation.
gaps.next_action: Obtain exchange transaction records that may document the fiat-to-crypto conversion during the 10:31–10:38 AM window.
